resolvedFindings.finding: The first validator accepted same-length mutations to V273 may-create and must-not-create sets, deferred owner proof and generated-file rules.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial SELF and MANAGER branch wording did not make actor-equals-owner selection mutually exclusive.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Evaluate only SELF when owner equals actor, require owner inequality for MANAGER, and fail closed for ambiguous, mixed or partial branches.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial self capability risk and future test paths diverged from canonical duty evidence and current repository topology.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use MEDIUM for the self Goal capability and duty, preserve manager HIGH and v62 semantics, replace stale paths with ProductAuthorizationGateTopologyValidator and ProductSurfaceRoutePolicies, and reject nonexistent People test paths.

resolvedFindings.finding: PER-008 IAQ-038 ownership, no-recount and preserved legacy GET and PUT routes were initially protected only by prose non-claims.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Validate the complete ownershipAndNoRecount object by exact equality and reject ownership transfer, recount, reclassification, dual-read or dual-write mutation.
